PR #2831 round 2 is pushed: head 06f8be4827790b478907bef54ac92f96050ffb38.
It fixes the config-trust blocker and TASK-2165..2167:
- The store-miss diagnosis now comes from the resolver's own walk (new aida_core::store_locate::locate_distributed_store_from), so there is no new config.toml read site.
- The AIDA_STORE note now also covers NoRoster, via store_sync::aida_store_override.
- A miss names every store_path candidate.
Targeted tests pass (bug_2200, bug_1723 config-trust, core store_locate), as do the portability ratchet and fmt.
BLOCKED: make test-touched and the build-backed fast gate refuse to build with: "cargo: error: refusing build: target filesystem has 11.5G (2.5%) free, below hard floor (15G)". `cargo reap` dry run finds 0 dirs to reclaim. I did not set AIDA_CARGO_DISK_MIN_GIB=0, and I've stopped here. The host disk needs freeing, or you can rely on CI for those gates.
subject: TASK-2072 PR #2831 round 2 pushed (head 06f8be4827); local build gates blocked by disk floor
